'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Eric White LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Eric White]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Rouge Rack Rocks'''. Line 1 reads Center of Tyranny / A Lib. world. Transcription notes: Line 19 written ''ACF''; Line 20 written ''Luke, Rebel Badass''; Line 21 written ''"''; Line 22 written ''"''; Line 28 written ''Wes Jansen, Rouge Smartass''. Lines shown in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card could not be identified for certain.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|Center Of Tyranny (V)]]
* '''Username:''' TheDigitalJawa
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
